description: This file provides centralized configuration management for the frontend of an LMS platform. It reads environment variables related to environment settings, URLs, feature flags, and other runtime configurations, with validation and default values. It exposes functions for retrieving API base URLs and constructing full API URLs.

methods.name: parseFeatureFlags
methods.description: Parses the REACT_APP_FEATURE_FLAGS environment variable, which can be JSON object, JSON array, or comma-separated string, into a normalized object mapping flag names to boolean values.

methods.name: getApiBase()
methods.description: Returns the primary API base URL, preferring REACT_APP_API_BASE over REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

methods.name: apiUrl(path = "")
methods.description: Builds a full API URL from a given path segment, ensuring proper slash separation.
